name: Dino's Pizza Time
description: The most popular and beloved restaurant at Mirabilandia — Dino's Pizza Time is a spectacular dinosaur-themed pizza restaurant in the Dinoland area serving freshly baked pizzas with classic Italian toppings alongside pasta dishes, salads and cold drinks. The theatrical dinosaur theming throughout the dining room creates a memorable atmosphere that children absolutely love and the quality of the pizza is consistently well above standard theme park levels. Dino's Pizza Time is the best value and most family-friendly dining option at Mirabilandia and typically draws the largest lunchtime crowds in the park.

name: Toro Seduto Saloon
description: The most atmospheric restaurant in Mirabilandia's Far West Valley — Toro Seduto Saloon is a classic American frontier saloon serving hearty western-inspired dishes including grilled chicken, burgers, ribs and fries in a magnificently themed setting complete with saloon bar, wagon wheel decor, country music and costumed staff. Particularly popular with families spending time in the Far West area between rides on El Dorado Falls and Gold Digger, the Toro Seduto Saloon captures the spirit of the American frontier with genuine charm and generous portions.

name: Cantina El Tesoro
description: A vibrant Mexican-inspired cantina in the adventure area of Mirabilandia serving burritos, tacos, nachos and quesadillas with authentic Mexican flavours and colourful Latin American decor. Cantina El Tesoro is the most distinctively flavoured food option at Mirabilandia and particularly popular with teenagers and young adults who want Mexican street food rather than standard pizza and pasta. The outdoor seating area makes it a pleasant spot for a quick lunch between the park's major thrill rides.

name: New York Deli
description: A classic New York-style deli themed to the post-apocalyptic Reset dark ride area — New York Deli serves generous American deli sandwiches, hot dogs, burgers and fries in a gritty urban setting with vintage New York advertising posters, chrome countertops and classic American diner aesthetics. The New York Deli is conveniently located near Reset and The Walking Dead making it the most natural food stop for thrill-seekers tackling the park's most intense attractions. Generous portions at reasonable prices.

name: Paddock Caffe
description: The restaurant of Ducati World — Paddock Caffe is a stylishly designed motorsport-themed cafe serving Italian espresso, pastries, panini, pasta and light meals in an immersive MotoGP paddock setting surrounded by Ducati racing memorabilia, vintage motorcycles and screens showing race footage. The Paddock Caffe is a genuinely distinctive and atmospheric dining experience for motorsport and coffee lovers who want to fuel up in the spirit of Italian racing culture before or after experiencing Desmo Race and the Ducati World exhibits.

name: Azuki Sushi
description: A surprisingly excellent sushi and Asian food restaurant offering a genuinely refreshing alternative to the Italian and American food options elsewhere in the park — Azuki Sushi serves fresh sushi rolls, sashimi, maki, noodle bowls and Asian-inspired dishes in a clean and contemporary setting. Azuki is particularly popular with adult visitors who want a lighter and more sophisticated lunch option and has developed a strong reputation for quality that exceeds expectations for a theme park food outlet. The sushi is prepared fresh throughout the day.
